text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen. For Maruzensky, it was a 
race full of history and meaning. A place 
where her fated rival might have been 
waiting...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, Maruzensky's current rival is me! 
Snorting with determination, Sakura 
Chiyono O fires up her fighting spirit for 
the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And then, who should be standing in the 
paddock but Mr. C.B. herself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Was it a clash between those who inherited 
a shared destiny, ...or perhaps a 
thrilling, joyous festival that only they, 
as they are now, could create?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The race between Mr. C.B. and Sakura 
Chiyono O was about to begin!
